name: GoldenMatch
description: Entity resolution toolkit for deduplication, record matching, golden records, and PPRL.

tools.name: analyze_data
tools.description: Profile data, detect domain, recommend ER strategy

file_content.description: Alternative to file_path: file bytes (base64 default, or raw with encoding='text')

tools.name: auto_configure
tools.description: Run AutoConfigController on a CSV; return the committed GoldenMatchConfig (incl. negative_evidence / Path Y when chosen) plus telemetry â stop_reason, health, decision trace, indicator column priors. Programmatic equivalent of `goldenmatch autoconfig`.

exclude_columns.description: Column names to skip across GoldenMatch + GoldenFlow + auto-config. Optional. Layered with config.exclude_columns when both are set. force_include (env var) rescues from any opt-out path.

file_content.description: Alternative to file_path: file bytes (base64 default, or raw with encoding='text')

tools.name: controller_telemetry
tools.description: Return the AutoConfigController telemetry from the most recent `auto_configure` or `agent_deduplicate` call in this MCP session. Same JSON shape as the web /api/v1/controller/telemetry endpoint.

tools.name: agent_deduplicate
tools.description: Run full ER pipeline with confidence gating and reasoning

exclude_columns.description: Column names to skip across GoldenMatch + GoldenFlow + auto-config. Optional. Layered with config.exclude_columns when both are set. force_include (env var) rescues from any opt-out path.

file_content.description: Alternative to file_path: file bytes (base64 default, or raw with encoding='text')

tools.name: agent_match_sources
tools.description: Match two files with intelligent strategy selection

exclude_columns.description: Column names to skip across GoldenMatch + GoldenFlow + auto-config. Optional. Layered with config.exclude_columns when both are set. force_include (env var) rescues from any opt-out path.

tools.name: agent_explain_pair
tools.description: Natural language explanation for a record pair

tools.name: agent_explain_cluster
tools.description: Explain why records are in the same cluster

tools.name: agent_review_queue
tools.description: Get borderline pairs awaiting approval

tools.name: agent_approve_reject
tools.description: Approve or reject a review queue pair

tools.name: agent_compare_strategies
tools.description: Compare ER strategies on your data

file_content.description: Alternative to file_path: file bytes (base64 default, or raw with encoding='text')

tools.name: suggest_pprl
tools.description: Check if data needs privacy-preserving matching

file_content.description: Alternative to file_path: file bytes (base64 default, or raw with encoding='text')

tools.name: scan_quality
tools.description: Run GoldenCheck data quality scan on a CSV file. Returns issues found (encoding errors, Unicode problems, format violations) without applying fixes. Requires goldencheck: pip install goldenmatch[quality]

file_path.description: Path to the CSV file to scan

file_content.description: Alternative to file_path: file bytes (base64 default, or raw with encoding='text')

tools.name: fix_quality
tools.description: Run GoldenCheck scan and apply fixes to a CSV file. Returns the fixed data summary and a manifest of all fixes applied. Requires goldencheck: pip install goldenmatch[quality]

file_path.description: Path to the CSV file to fix

fix_mode.description: Fix aggressiveness: safe (conservative) or moderate (balanced). Default: safe

output_path.description: Optional path to save the fixed CSV. If omitted, returns summary only.

file_content.description: Alternative to file_path: file bytes (base64 default, or raw with encoding='text')

tools.name: run_transforms
tools.description: Run GoldenFlow data transforms on a CSV file. Normalizes phone numbers (E.164), dates (ISO), categorical spelling, and Unicode issues. Returns a manifest of transforms applied. Requires goldenflow: pip install goldenmatch[transform]

file_path.description: Path to the CSV file to transform

output_path.description: Optional path to save the transformed CSV. If omitted, returns summary only.

file_content.description: Alternative to file_path: file bytes (base64 default, or raw with encoding='text')

tools.name: sensitivity
tools.description: Parameter-sensitivity analysis: sweep one or more config parameters across a range and report how stable the clustering is at each value (CCMS unchanged %). Use it to find robust thresholds. Auto-configures the file if no config is given.

sweep.description: Sweep specs as 'field:start:stop:step', e.g. 'threshold:0.70:0.95:0.05'. One or more.

sample_size.description: Optional: randomly sample N records before sweeping

file_content.description: Alternative to file_path: file bytes (base64 default, or raw with encoding='text')

tools.name: incremental
tools.description: Match a batch of new records against an existing base dataset (without re-running the whole base). Returns matched (new_row_id, base_row_id, score) pairs plus counts. Auto-configures from the base file if no config is given.

new_records.description: New records file to match in

tools.name: certify_recall
tools.description: Estimate match RECALL without ground truth (unsupervised). Treats each auto-configured matchkey/pass as a decorrelated system and uses capture-recapture over their overlaps to estimate how many true matches were missed. Returns a point estimate (a safe lower bound additionally needs a small labelled audit; see `goldenmatch evaluate --certify --audit-out`). Needs >=3 decorrelated systems.

file_content.description: Alternative to file_path: file bytes (base64 default, or raw with encoding='text')

tools.name: retrieve_similar
tools.description: Semantic retrieval (#1089): return the records in a CSV most similar to a free-text query, ranked by cosine similarity. Embeds the chosen column and the query with the zero-config in-house embedder (no cloud/torch by default) and runs ANN search. The read side of the RAG entity-canonicalization epic -- fetch candidate records by query without running a full dedupe.

column.description: Column of the corpus to embed + search

model.description: Embedder id (default 'inhouse' -- local, deterministic, no cloud/torch). Also 'all-MiniLM-L6-v2', a Vertex/OpenAI model, etc.

filters.description: Optional {column: value} equality pre-filter applied before embedding

file_content.description: Alternative to file_path: file bytes (base64 default, or raw with encoding='text')

tools.name: upload_dataset
tools.description: Upload a local file's bytes to the server and get back a server-side path to reuse across other tools (analyze_data, auto_configure, agent_deduplicate, ...). No hosting needed. Send base64 (default) or raw text via `encoding`. Uploaded files are ephemeral scratch, reaped after GOLDENMATCH_MCP_UPLOAD_TTL (default 24h); re-upload if you need a path older than that. Max size GOLDENMATCH_MCP_MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES (default 64MB) -- above it, pass a public http(s) URL as file_path instead.

file_content.description: File bytes, base64-encoded (or raw text with encoding='text')

filename.description: Original filename (extension preserved for format sniffing)

tools.name: list_corrections
tools.description: List stored Learning Memory corrections, optionally filtered by dataset. Returns id_a, id_b, decision, source, trust, reason, matchkey_name, dataset, original_score, created_at.

tools.name: add_correction
tools.description:
Add a Learning Memory correction. Two shapes:
  - pair-level: decision='approve' or 'reject', requires id_a + id_b
  - field-level (v1.18.2+): decision='field_correct', requires cluster_id + field_name + corrected_value
Source is 'agent' with trust=0.5 (lower than human steward 1.0). Pair (id_a, id_b) is canonicalized to (min, max) before storage.

id_a.description: Pair-level: first row id. Field-level: ignored.

id_b.description: Pair-level: second row id. Field-level: ignored.

corrected_value.description: Field-level: the value the reviewer changed it to.

dataset.description: Dataset identifier (e.g. file path). Required, non-empty.

tools.name: list_plugins
tools.description: List all registered goldenmatch plugins by category. Includes the 22 v1.18.2 predefined plugins (numeric/format/business/aggregation) plus any user-registered plugins via entry-points or PluginRegistry.register_*(). Each entry includes name, source (builtin or user), category, and the first line of the merge docstring.

tools.name: learn_thresholds
tools.description: Force a MemoryLearner pass over accumulated corrections. Returns the list of LearnedAdjustments produced (matchkey_name, threshold, sample_size, learned_at). Requires >= 10 corrections per matchkey before threshold tuning fires; otherwise returns an empty list.

matchkey_name.description: Optional: learn only for this matchkey.

tools.name: memory_stats
tools.description: Return Learning Memory status: total correction count, last learn time, and current learned adjustments. Cheap; safe for status checks.

tools.name: memory_export
tools.description: Return all corrections as a list of dicts (CSV-shaped). Caller is responsible for writing the file. Optionally filter by dataset.

tools.name: memory_import
tools.description: Import corrections from a list of dicts (the exact shape memory_export returns). Upserts into the store: higher trust wins, same trust = latest wins. Returns the count imported.

corrections.description: Correction dicts, as returned by memory_export.

tools.name: identity_resolve
tools.description: Resolve a record_id to its durable identity. Returns the full identity view (members, evidence edges, recent events) or null when no identity exists for that record.

tools.name: identity_list
tools.description: List identities, optionally filtered by dataset/status.

tools.name: identity_history
tools.description: Return the temporal event log for an identity.

tools.name: identity_conflicts
tools.description: List evidence edges marked `conflicts_with`.

tools.name: identity_merge
tools.description: Manually merge two identities. All records from `absorb_entity_id` are reassigned to `keep_entity_id`. The merge events are stamped with `actor`/`trust` provenance so the audit log records who merged these and on what authority.

actor.description: Principal making the change, e.g. 'agent:claude' or 'steward:alice'. Defaults to 'agent'.

trust.description: Trust of the actor in [0,1]. Defaults by actor prefix (steward 1.0, agent 0.5).

tools.name: identity_split
tools.description: Split a subset of records off an identity into a brand-new identity. The original keeps the remaining records. The split events carry `actor`/`trust` provenance.

actor.description: Principal making the change, e.g. 'agent:claude'. Defaults to 'agent'.

trust.description: Trust of the actor in [0,1]. Default by actor prefix.

tools.name: identity_claim
tools.description: Claim a record into an identity, moving it out of any prior entity ('this record belongs to that identity'). Emits a provenance-stamped `claimed` event on both the gaining and losing entities.

entity_id.description: Entity to claim the record into

trust.description: Trust in [0,1]. Default by actor prefix.

tools.name: identity_resolve_conflict
tools.description: Adjudicate a `conflicts_with` pair: 'same' keeps the entity intact, 'distinct' splits the second record out into a new identity, 'defer' only logs. Records a durable mediation verdict + event with actor/trust provenance, and stops the conflict re-surfacing in the open-conflicts queue.

apply.description: Act on the verdict (split on 'distinct'); false = log only.

trust.description: Trust in [0,1]. Default by actor prefix.

tools.name: identity_audit
tools.description: Export the append-only identity audit log in commit order: every event with actor / trust / timestamp / reason, so a reviewer can reconstruct exactly which actor changed what, when, and why. Optionally filtered by dataset / actor.

tools.name: identity_audit_seal
tools.description: Anchor the append-only audit log with a tamper-evidence seal: a chained sha256 root over every event since the last seal. Cheap and idempotent (a no-op when nothing new has been logged). Run it periodically (or after a batch of stewardship actions) so the history becomes provably untampered. Optionally scoped to a dataset. Publish/mirror the returned root_hash to make tampering detectable by an external party.

actor.description: Principal sealing the log. Defaults to 'agent'.

tools.name: identity_audit_verify
tools.description: Verify the append-only audit log against its seal chain. Replays the per-event content hashes and the seal roots to detect content edits, deletion, reordering, and insertion of any sealed event. Returns {ok, events_checked, seals_checked} plus the ids of any content mismatches / broken seals / missing sealed events. Optionally scoped to a dataset.

tools.name: identity_show
tools.description: Fetch the full detail of one identity by entity_id: its member records, evidence edges, and recent event log. Returns {found: false} when no such entity exists.

tools.name: identity_profile
tools.description: MDM profile of one entity: record count + per-source breakdown, golden record, confidence, conflict count, canonical version (structural-event count), and first/last activity. Returns {found: false} when no such entity exists.

tools.name: identity_stats
tools.description: Graph-level summary / health stats: entities by status, total records, records-per-entity distribution, conflict total, source mix, and the largest entities. Optionally scoped to a dataset.

tools.name: identity_worklist
tools.description: Prioritized steward worklist: active entities needing attention (open conflicts and/or confidence below weak_confidence), highest conflict count first.

tools.name: plan_routing
tools.description: Project per-stage distributed routing (scoring/clustering/golden) for a given data shape + cluster. Pure; no controller run.

tools.name: explain_routing
tools.description: Human-readable explanation of why each stage is routed the way it is, with the driver-RAM projection that drove it.

tools.name: lint_routing
tools.description: Flag config/env overrides that force a slow path (e.g. CLUSTERING_THRESHOLD=0 when the edge set fits driver RAM). ERROR at scale; would_refuse mirrors the runtime guard.

tools.name: get_stats
tools.description: Get dataset statistics: record count, cluster count, match rate, cluster sizes.

tools.name: find_duplicates
tools.description: Find duplicate matches for a record. Provide field values to search against the loaded dataset.

tools.name: explain_match
tools.description: Explain why two records match or don't match. Shows per-field score breakdown.

tools.name: list_clusters
tools.description: List duplicate clusters found in the dataset. Returns cluster IDs, sizes, and member counts.

tools.name: get_cluster
tools.description: Get details of a specific cluster: all member records and their field values.

tools.name: get_golden_record
tools.description: Get the merged golden (canonical) record for a cluster.

tools.name: match_record
tools.description: Match a single record against the loaded dataset in real-time. Paste a record's fields and instantly see if it matches any existing record. Uses the configured matchkeys, scorers, and thresholds. Example: {"name": "John Smith", "email": "john@test.com", "zip": "10001"}

record.description: Record fields to match against the dataset

threshold.description: Minimum score to consider a match (default: use config threshold)

tools.name: unmerge_record
tools.description: Remove a record from its cluster. The record becomes a singleton. Remaining cluster members are re-clustered using stored pair scores. Use this to fix bad merges.

record_id.description: Row ID of the record to unmerge

tools.name: shatter_cluster
tools.description: Break an entire cluster into individual records. All members become singletons. Use when a cluster is completely wrong.

tools.name: suggest_config
tools.description: Analyze bad merges and suggest config changes. Provide examples of incorrect merges (pairs that should NOT have matched) and GoldenMatch will identify which fields/thresholds to tighten. Example: [{"record_a": {...}, "record_b": {...}, "reason": "different people"}]

bad_merges.description: List of bad merge examples with record_a, record_b, and optional reason

tools.name: review_config
tools.description: Run the config healer over the loaded dataset: analyze the dedupe run and return ranked, self-verified suggestions for improving the matching config (thresholds, scorers, negative evidence, blocking). Each suggestion carries an id, kind, target, rationale, and a machine-applicable patch. Requires the native kernel (pip install goldenmatch[native]); returns an empty list otherwise.

tools.name: profile_data
tools.description: Get data quality profile: column types, null rates, unique counts, sample values.

tools.name: export_results
tools.description: Export matching results to a file (CSV or JSON).

tools.name: list_domains
tools.description: List available domain extraction rulebooks (built-in + user-defined).

tools.name: create_domain
tools.description: Create a custom domain extraction rulebook. Define patterns for a specific data domain (medical devices, automotive parts, real estate, etc.).

signals.description: Column name keywords that trigger this domain (e.g. ['ndc', 'fda', 'implant'])

identifier_patterns.description: Named regex patterns for domain identifiers (e.g. {'ndc': '\\b(\\d{5}-\\d{4}-\\d{2})\\b'})

attribute_patterns.description: Named regex patterns for domain attributes (e.g. {'size': '\\b(\\d+mm)\\b'})

stop_words.description: Words to strip during name normalization

scope.description: Save locally (.goldenmatch/domains/) or globally (~/.goldenmatch/domains/). Default: local.

tools.name: test_domain
tools.description: Test a domain extraction rulebook against sample records. Shows what features would be extracted from the loaded data.

domain_name.description: Name of the domain rulebook to test

tools.name: pprl_auto_config
tools.description: Analyze the loaded dataset and recommend optimal PPRL (privacy-preserving record linkage) configuration. Returns recommended fields, bloom filter parameters, threshold, and explanation.

use_llm.description: Use LLM for enhanced recommendations (requires API key)

tools.name: pprl_link
tools.description: Run privacy-preserving record linkage between two parties' data. Computes bloom filters, matches records without sharing raw data. Specify fields, threshold, and security level.

file_a.description: Path to party A's CSV file

file_b.description: Path to party B's CSV file

tools.name: evaluate
tools.description: Score the loaded run against ground-truth pairs. Loads a ground-truth CSV (id_a,id_b columns) and returns precision, recall, and F1 for the current clustering.

ground_truth_path.description: CSV of true match pairs (columns id_a,id_b or idA,idB).

tools.name: analyze_blocking
tools.description: Diagnose blocking on the loaded dataset: returns ranked blocking key candidates with block counts, max block size, total candidate comparisons, and estimated recall. Use it to explain why matching is slow or produces too many candidate pairs.

tools.name: compare_clusters
tools.description: Compare two ER clustering outcomes on the same dataset without ground truth (CCMS): classifies each cluster as unchanged / merged / partitioned / overlapping and returns the Talburt-Wang Index. Both inputs are JSON cluster files (as written by export-style output).

clusters_a_content.description: Alternative to clusters_a_path: base64/text bytes (JSON, use encoding='text')

clusters_b_content.description: Alternative to clusters_b_path: base64/text bytes (JSON, use encoding='text')

tools.name: schema_match
tools.description: Auto-map columns between two files with different schemas. Returns proposed (col_a, col_b) mappings with a confidence score and method (synonym / name_sim / composite). Useful before matching two sources.

tools.name: lineage
tools.description: Field-level provenance for the loaded run: for each scored pair, the per-field scores that produced the match, plus cluster id. Optionally write a lineage JSON to a directory.

output_dir.description: If set, write lineage JSON here and return the path instead of inline records.

tools.name: list_runs
tools.description: List previous dedupe/match runs (for rollback) from the run log.

tools.name: rollback
tools.description: Undo a previous run by DELETING its output files (looked up by run_id in the run log). Destructive: removes the files that run wrote. Use list_runs first to find the run_id.

tools.name: config_weaknesses
tools.description: Diagnose weaknesses in the loaded run's auto-config: columns admitted that shouldn't be (source/provenance labels, per-row IDs), oversized or shared-value blocks, null sinks, low-signal matchkeys, and over-merging. Returns ranked findings, each with a plain-English explanation + a concrete fix, plus a one-paragraph summary.

max_findings.description: Max findings to return, ranked by severity (default 6).

phrasing.description: Wording style for the findings (default plain).

tools.name: dedupe
tools.description: Alias for `find_duplicates`. Find duplicate matches for a record. Provide field values to search against the loaded dataset.

tools.name: match
tools.description: Alias for `match_record`. Match a single record against the loaded dataset in real-time. Paste a record's fields and instantly see if it matches any existing record. Uses the configured matchkeys, scorers, and thresholds. Example: {"name": "John Smith", "email": "john@test.com", "zip": "10001"}

record.description: Record fields to match against the dataset

threshold.description: Minimum score to consider a match (default: use config threshold)

tools.name: explain_pair
tools.description: Alias for `explain_match`. Explain why two records match or don't match. Shows per-field score breakdown.

tools.name: profile
tools.description: Alias for `profile_data`. Get data quality profile: column types, null rates, unique counts, sample values.

tools.name: explain_cluster
tools.description: Alias for `agent_explain_cluster`. Explain why records are in the same cluster

tools.name: documents_suggest_schema
tools.description: Propose a target extraction schema (JSON) from a sample document image/PDF.

tools.name: documents_ingest
tools.description: Extract records from documents (PDF/image) against a target schema into rows ready for dedupe_df. Returns records + an ingest report.
